responsibility: Set up display modes, views and materials in Rhino 9, and export image batches checked file by file against the requested display mode.
inputs: The open Rhino 9 document reached through the Rhino AI panel's Rhino tools, the user's request and the output folder they name. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: Only for a requested image batch; the PNGs are read back and checked. Also this skill's lessons, appended in the plugin data folder the startup line names.
